estimated: usable value. zero: Ks = 0 (near-identical copies; 167 HAP1 and 361 HAP2 tandem pairs passing the coverage check); cannot be drawn on a log axis. low_alignment_coverage: tandem pair whose codon alignment failed the coverage check (Ks_alignment_coverage_ok False); a value is given but was not used for dating. at_ceiling: the estimate returned the program's ceiling value 99 (saturated; one tandem pair); Ks is empty, the pair still counts among the 16,238 dated tandem pairs and sits in the aWGT_era bin. not_estimated: no Ks was computed (cross-haplotype syntelog pairs).

Criterion 1: the gene model fails the Chapter 2 gene-model quality filter, or is one of three spuriously long PS19 models. Each criterion column is evaluated independently of the others.
Criterion 2 (PS18 only): abSENSE predicts that the absence of homologs outside Populus is a plausible homology-detection failure.
Criterion 3: the protein has a tBLASTn hit (E-value <= 1e-5, >= 30% of the query) overlapping an annotated gene inside the syntenic window of an outgroup genome.

Criterion 4: spliced reads join the gene to its conserved same-strand upstream neighbor (at least three reads and above the 99th percentile of opposite-strand neighbor pairs), so the model is likely a fragment of that neighbor.
